rows.name: ARANMORE ISLAND
rows.character: One rev. red and br. lt. Lower fixed red light
rows.description: White tower, 76 ft. high, on Rinrawros Pt. Lt. shows alternate red and bright flashes (of equal intensity) every 20 secs. Lower lt. red to eastward over Stag Rocks, between N.E. by E. ½ E. and E. by N.

rows.name: RATHLIN-O-BIRNE
rows.character: One fixed br. or red lt.
rows.description: White tower, 65 ft. high, on West side. Lt. is bright seaward from N.E. ½ N. to S.E. by S. ½ S. Red towards mainland and sound

rows.name: Killybegs
rows.description: White tower, 47 ft. high, on St. John Point

rows.name: Rotten Island
rows.character: One fix. br. or red lt.
rows.description: White tower, 47 feet high. Red sector over Bullockmore Rock, between S.W. ¾ S. and S.W. by W. ¾ W.

rows.name: Black Rock
rows.description: White lighthouse, 94 ft. high, South side of harbour entrance

rows.name: Oyster Island
rows.description: Two fixed bright lights; in one, S.E. ¾ S.

rows.name: Killala Bay
rows.description: In tower of Ross Coastguard Station; visible bet. E. by N. ½ N. & E. by S. ½ S., through E.

rows.name: Broadhaven
rows.character: One fix. bright or red lt.
rows.description: Lt.-ho., 50 ft. high, on Gubacashel Pt. Bright to seaward; red toward W. side of harbour

rows.name: EAGLE ISLAND
rows.description: White towers, 87 & 64 ft. high. In one, E. by N. ½ N. or W. by S. ½ S., 132 yds. apart, clear all rocks off Black Sod Bay and Broadhaven

rows.name: BLACK ROCK
rows.description: White tower, 50 ft. high, on West extremity. Light red toward land, from N.E. by E. ½ E. to S.E. by E. Bright seaward

rows.name: Black Sod Quay
rows.character: One fixed br. or red lt.
rows.description: House on Black Sod Point. Light red between N.E. ¾ N. & N.E. by E. (19°); thence bright to S.W.

rows.name: CLARE ISLAND
rows.description: White lighthouse, 39 ft. high, on North Point

rows.name: Inishgort Island
rows.description: One fixed bright light, entrance to Westport

rows.name: SLYNE HEAD
rows.character: One rev. light, 2 min. One fixed bright light
rows.description: Two towers, 79 ft. high, on Illaunimmul Id. N. light rev.; once red, & twice bright. S. light fixed. In one, N. ½ E., 142 yds. apart, lead outside of rocks

rows.name: EERAGH ISLAND
rows.description: White tower, 101 ft. high, with two red belts, on West point

rows.name: Straw Island
rows.description: White buildings, Killeany B. Shown betw. W. by N. ½ N. & S.E. Vis. from inside Arran Is.

rows.name: Inisheer Island
rows.character: One fix. br. or red lt.
rows.description: White tower, 112 ft. high, with broad red belt, on S. point. Light is red over Finnis Rock

rows.name: Mutton Island
rows.description: White lighthouse, 34 ft. high, on centre of island, off Galway

rows.name: LOOP HEAD
rows.description: White tower, 75 ft. high, 500 yds. from extr. of head. Lt. bright 20 secs., eclipsed 4 secs. Shown from N.E. by E. ½ E. to S.E. by E.

rows.name: Kilcradan
rows.character: One fix. br. or red lt.
rows.description: White lighthouse, 43 feet high, on the point. Light red to seaward; bright to river

rows.name: Scattery Island
rows.character: One fix. br. or red lt.
rows.description: White tower on S. point. Lt. is red over Rinana Shoal, betw. S.S.W. & S.W. by W. ½ W. Bright lt. eclipsed landward betw. N.E. ¾ E. and N.W. by W. ½ W.

rows.name: Tarbert
rows.description: White lighthouse, 54 ft. high, on the rock

rows.name: Beeves Rocks
rows.character: One fix. br. or red lt.
rows.description: Light red to North of rocks. Eighteen small lights below Limerick

rows.name: Tralee
rows.character: One fixed br. or red lt.
rows.description: On Little Samphire Island. Lt. bright seaward, from N. ½ E. to W. by N. ½ N., thence red over anchorage to E. by S. ¾ S. Also a lt. on end of canal North pier

rows.name: TEARAGHT ISLAND
rows.description: White lt.-ho., 57 ft. high. Lt. shown betw. S. ¾ E. and E. by N. ¾ N.; two flashes in 15 secs., followed by 45 secs. darkness

rows.name: Valentia
rows.description: White tower, 48 ft. high, on Cromwell's Fort. Lt. vis. betw. N.E. by N. ¾ N. & N.W. ¼ W.
